sections.heading: Section C — Rules of the Road (Handbook Sec. 9)
sections.markdown:
# Section C -- Rules of the Road

Coverage is Handbook Section 9, printed pp. 39-50. [A01]

FACT_ID: C-FLEX-01 | anchor: A01
Flex lanes use overhead signals; green arrow means use lane, red X means closed. [A01]
Lanes may reverse direction by time of day for rush-hour flow. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: C-FWY-01 | anchor: A01
Keep at least two seconds following distance behind the vehicle ahead on freeways. [A01]
Increase the gap further when conditions are adverse. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: C-FWY-02 | anchor: A01
A vehicle in the left lane must move safely right when approached from behind to avoid impeding. [A01]
A citation for impeding may be issued if the driver does not yield the left lane. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: C-FWY-03 | anchor: A01
U-turns on the freeway and driving or stopping in the emergency lane are illegal. [A01]
Using an entrance ramp to exit and passing only when unsafe are prohibited. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: C-EXP-01 | anchor: A02
Express lanes on I-15 allow vehicles with two or more persons free of charge. [A02]
Motorcycles, buses, and registered C-decal vehicles may also use them free. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: C-EXP-02 | anchor: A02
Crossing a double white line to enter or leave the carpool lane is illegal. [A02]
Entry and exit are allowed only at dotted-stripe access points about 3000 feet long. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: C-EXP-03 | anchor: A02
Single-occupant users need an express pass with an active account linked to a card. [A02]
When followed by a flashing emergency vehicle it is permissible to move safely right out. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: C-CDEC-01 | anchor: A02
A C decal allows limited single-occupant clean-fuel vehicles to use express lanes without toll. [A02]
It requires a one-time 10 dollar registration fee and windshield placement by the mirror. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: C-ENTRY-01 | anchor: A02
Use the acceleration lane to match roadway speed before merging onto a multi-lane highway. [A02]
Find a gap, merge, then cancel the turn signal. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: C-EXIT-01 | anchor: A02
Move to the exit lane early, keep steady speed on the main road, then slow in the exit lane. [A02]
Signal, check posted exit speed, and cancel the signal after moving over. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: C-RAMP-01 | anchor: A03
Ramp meters show only red and green and release one vehicle per green unless posted otherwise. [A03]
They operate only when the lighted meter-on sign at the on-ramp entrance is illuminated. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: C-RUN-01 | anchor: A03
A runaway vehicle ramp may be used only in an emergency to stop the vehicle. [A03]
Stopping, standing, or parking on or in the path of such a ramp is prohibited. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: C-SPUI-01 | anchor: A03
A U-turn from the off-ramp at a single-point interchange is legal only facing a green arrow. [A03]
Do not stop mid-intersection once started, and do not treat a power outage as a four-way stop. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: C-INT-01 | anchor: A04
At intersections slow, search, and after stopping look left, right, then left again. [A04]
Do not change lanes while proceeding through the intersection and yield to occupants inside. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: C-CFI-01 | anchor: A04
A continuous-flow left turn crosses oncoming lanes on the first green then turns on the second green. [A04]
Free-right and traditional right-on-red are restricted there; obey posted controls. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: C-DDI-01 | anchor: A05
A diverging diamond briefly shifts non-freeway traffic to the opposite side over or under the freeway. [A05]
A thru-U-turn route goes through, U-turns away from the junction, returns, then turns right. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: C-MARK-01 | anchor: A05
Yellow markings divide opposing directions; white markings divide same-direction flow. [A05]
A double white line separating express lanes from general lanes must not be crossed. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: C-MARK-02 | anchor: A06
Stop behind the stop line or crosswalk and yield to pedestrians in marked or unmarked crosswalks. [A06]
Do not enter a shared center left-turn lane more than 500 feet before the turn. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: C-SPEED-01 | anchor: A06
Basic law requires only reasonable and prudent speed for conditions. [A06]
Absent signs and hazards the handbook lists 20, 25, 55, and 65 to 80 mph settings by area. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: C-SPEED-02 | anchor: A07
Slow for intersections, curves, hill crests, narrow roads, work zones, and poor visibility. [A07]
Do not drive so slowly as to impede normal flow; officers may cite impeding drivers. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: C-SIG-01 | anchor: A07
Green means go if clear; yellow means the signal is about to turn red. [A07]
Flashing yellow means slow and proceed with caution prepared to stop. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: C-SIG-02 | anchor: A08
Red means stop behind the line until green; right on red is allowed after a full stop unless posted. [A08]
Red arrows prohibit the indicated turn; flashing red requires stop and check both ways. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: C-SIGN-01 | anchor: A09
Regulatory signs state lane use and limits; warning signs are diamond yellow; work zones are orange. [A09]
Fines for speeding in a work zone are doubled and flaggers must be obeyed. [A09]
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: C-ROW-01 | anchor: A12
Yield to the vehicle already in the intersection, oncoming traffic on left turns, and pedestrians. [A12]
At a dark-signal intersection stop first and yield right; always obey an officer over signals. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0060]

Misconceptions: left lane is for cruising; right on red is always allowed; crosswalk needs paint.

Mnemonics: flex uses arrow language; express uses dotted doors; signals use stop-then-decide.

Glossary: flex lane; express lane; access point; ramp meter; diverging diamond; shared center lane.

Dynamic-fact isolation: express toll rates and C-decal eligibility lists change; check UDOT.
